maya: Quick async handoff — Optimize toolkit quant+batch/cache recommendations are ready for engineering review. Owners: batching -> @jordan, caching/TTL -> @nisha, quant profiles -> @alex. Please ack and call out blockers.

jordan: Ack. I'll pick up batching perf tests. ETA EOD Thurs. Do you have the sample perf harness?

maya: yup, link in docs: https://redwood/internal/optimize/harness (private). see snippet below for run command:

```
./run_perf --model rwn-13B-q4 --batch_sizes 1,2,4 --seq 512 --warmup 250
```

nisha: Ack. I'll validate caching TTL tradeoffs and add recommended defaults. One question: should we prefer prefix caching or KV-only for short chat workloads?

alex: I lean KV-only for now (simpler) unless prefix cache shows <5% improvement in early experiments. I'll validate quant profiles on the 4-bit variants and open PR for perf flags.

jordan: quick ping — do we have a regression alert hook for rollout? want to wire it to the eval set.

nisha: yes, we've got the eval alert; can wire to model route in console. I'll draft alert thresholds: latency +10% or quality drop >2% on eval prompts.

ci-cd-bot: build 9832 passed (optkit/quant-profiles) :white_check_mark:

alex: created PR https://git.internal/redwood/optimize/pulls/128 — includes quant config + test harness update. reviewers: @maya @jordan

maya: added reviewers. If no blockers, plan to cut canary on Dedicated Monday and monitor regression alerts. :calendar:

jordan: noted. will add batching A/B flag and smoke test.

nisha: i'll attach TTL recommendations and alert wiring doc by EOD tomorrow. :memo:

maya: perfect, thanks all. If anything urgent ping #eng-oncall. Closing this thread for async tracking — updates to PR or doc will surface here. :thumbsup:
